statement: Declared Cell memory is admission-reserved the way storage already is: the placement admission ledger tracks per-node reservedBytes for declared Cell memory, mirroring the existing storage-admission reservedBytes pattern, so the planner cannot admit Cells whose summed declared memory exceeds node capacity, and the runtime-memory-admission-reservation scenario is green.

constraints.statement: The memory reservation ledger mirrors the existing storage-admission reservedBytes owner and accounting shape; no second ledger design or parallel admission authority is introduced.
